title: Pure Buster Blader
summary: Buster Blader and Destruction Sword cards paired with Trap Trick, Level 1 searchers, and generic staples. By deploying Buster Dragon alongside Buster Blader, the Dragon Destroyer Swordsman on the opponent's turn, the deck turns all opposing monsters into Defense Position Dragons that cannot activate their effects.

summary.title: Starters
points: Buster Whelp of the Destruction Swordsman searches any Destruction Sword card on Normal Summon (usually Prologue of the Destruction Swordsman), Tributes itself to Special Summon Buster Blader from the hand or GY, and discards a Destruction Sword card to revive itself from the GY.

One for One discards a card to Special Summon Buster Whelp or Dragon Buster Destruction Sword directly from the Deck, while Where Arf Thou? searches Dragon Buster Destruction Sword while you control Buster Whelp.
Trap Trick banishes 1 copy of Prologue of the Destruction Swordsman or Destruction Sword Memories from the Deck to Set another copy directly to your field, ready to activate that turn.

summary.title: Opening: Buster Whelp (1-Card Buster Lock)
steps: Normal Summon Buster Whelp of the Destruction Swordsman and search Prologue of the Destruction Swordsman; Set Prologue (and Link Summon Linkuriboh or Protector Whelp if you have a second monster to dump Destruction Sword Memories).

On the opponent's turn, activate Prologue of the Destruction Swordsman by sending Destruction Sword Memories (or Dragon Buster Destruction Sword) and Buster Blader from your Deck to the GY as cost to Special Summon Buster Dragon from the Extra Deck.

Banish Destruction Sword Memories from the GY to Fusion Summon Buster Blader, the Dragon Destroyer Swordsman by banishing Buster Blader and Dragon Buster Destruction Sword from your GY, then use Buster Dragon on the opponent's turn to equip Dragon Buster Destruction Sword from the GY to Buster Blader.

summary.title: The Buster Lock & Destruction Sword Equips
summary.text: Buster Dragon continuously changes all monsters the opponent controls into Dragon monsters, while Buster Blader, the Dragon Destroyer Swordsman changes all Dragon monsters the opponent controls to Defense Position and prevents Dragon monsters in their possession from activating their effects. Because Buster Dragon can also equip a Destruction Sword monster from your GY to a Buster Blader you control once per turn during the opponent's turn, equipping Dragon Buster Destruction Sword locks the opponent out of Special Summoning from the Extra Deck, Wizard Buster Destruction Sword stops GY monster effects, and Robot Buster Destruction Sword stops face-up Spell/Trap effect activations.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Buster Blader, the Dragon Destroyer Swordsman gains 1000 ATK and DEF for each Dragon on the field or in the GYs, inflicts piercing battle damage, and shuts down all opposing monsters once Buster Dragon turns them into Dragons.
Protector Whelp of the Destruction Swordsman sends any Destruction Sword card from the Deck to the GY on Link Summon and Special Summons a Buster Blader from the hand.

Destruction Sword Flash banishes all monsters the opponent controls while you control a Fusion Monster that lists Buster Blader as material, and banishes itself from the GY to negate targeting effects.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Prologue of the Destruction Swordsman sends a Destruction Sword card and Buster Blader to the GY as cost (so Ash Blossom cannot negate the dump) to summon Buster Dragon, and banishes itself from the GY to protect your Destruction Sword cards from destruction.

Destruction Sword Memories Special Summons a Buster Blader from the Deck on the field and banishes itself from the GY to Fusion Summon Buster Blader, the Dragon Destroyer Swordsman using GY materials.
Emblem of Dragon Destroyer adds Buster Blader from the Deck or GY to the hand, and Karma of the Destruction Swordsman banishes same-Type monsters from the opponent's GY.

allow.Where Arf Thou?: Searches any Level 1 Destruction Sword Whelp while you control Buster Whelp of the Destruction Swordsman.
allow.One for One: Discards a Destruction Sword card to Special Summon Buster Whelp directly from the Deck.
allow.Foolish Burial: Sends Buster Blader or Destruction Sword Memories to the GY to set up Prologue combos.
allow.Trap Trick: Banishes 1 Prologue of the Destruction Swordsman from the Deck to set another copy directly to the field.
allow.Protector Whelp of the Destruction Sword: Archetypal Link-2 monster that dumps a Destruction Sword card on Link Summon and Special Summons Buster Blader from hand.
allow.Linkuriboh: Converts Level 1 Buster Whelp or Dragon Buster Destruction Sword into a GY resource while protecting LP.

main: Buster Whelp of the Destruction Swordsman
Core starter that searches any Destruction Sword card on Normal Summon and tributes itself to summon Buster Blader.
Buster Blader
Iconic Level 7 Warrior required in the Deck/GY for Prologue of the Destruction Swordsman and Destruction Sword Memories.
Buster Blader, the Destruction Swordmaster
Treats its name as 'Buster Blader' on the field or in the GY and destroys opposing monsters to equip them.
Dragon Buster Destruction Sword
Equips to Buster Blader (via Buster Dragon) to completely lock the opponent out of Special Summoning from the Extra Deck.
Wizard Buster Destruction Sword
Equips to Buster Blader to prevent the opponent from activating monster effects in the GY.
Robot Buster Destruction Sword
Equips to Buster Blader to prevent face-up Spells/Traps the opponent controls from activating their effects.
Karma of the Destruction Swordsman
Banishes monsters of the same Type from the opponent's GY to boost ATK and discards a Destruction Sword card to recover itself.
Destruction Sword Memories
Trap that discards a Destruction Sword card to summon Buster Blader from Deck, and banishes from GY to Fusion Summon Dragon Destroyer Swordsman.
Prologue of the Destruction Swordsman
Core Trap that sends a Destruction Sword card and a Buster Blader from Deck to GY to cheat out Buster Dragon from the Extra Deck.
Destruction Sword Flash
Trap that banishes all monsters the opponent controls if you control a Fusion Monster that lists Buster Blader as material.
Emblem of Dragon Destroyer
Adds Buster Blader from the Deck or GY to the hand.
Trap Trick
Acts as copies 4-6 of Prologue of the Destruction Swordsman or Destruction Sword Memories.
Where Arf Thou?
Searches Dragon Buster Destruction Sword after Normal Summoning Buster Whelp.
One for One
Summons Buster Whelp or Dragon Buster Destruction Sword from the Deck.
Foolish Burial
Sends Buster Blader or Dragon Buster Destruction Sword to the GY.
extra: Buster Blader, the Dragon Destroyer Swordsman
Fusion boss that gains 1000 ATK/DEF per Dragon, forces all opponent's Dragons to Defense Position, and prevents them from activating effects.
Level 8 Synchro summoned by Prologue that turns all opponent's monsters into Dragons and equips a Destruction Sword from GY to Buster Blader.
Protector Whelp of the Destruction Swordsman
Link-2 that sends Destruction Sword Memories from Deck to GY on Link Summon and inflicts burn damage.
Link-1 used to send Buster Whelp to the GY when needed.
